name: Tribeswoman
source:
"Despite her primitive trappings, this woman can easily stand toe-to-toe with any fighter." - In-game description

Tribeswoman is a monster that can first be encountered on the ninth floor, but cannot be captured until reaching the tenth. If the party discovers the Tribeswoman in the secret grotto, she is quite protective of her home and will not let the party explore it without fighting her; upon her defeat, the player must select one of three nearby bushes to collect upgrade seeds from. 

Following her capture, the Tribeswoman [url=/c48304]Yomi[/url] recruits laments that although she and her fellow tribe members can sense something wrong with the dungeon, they have not been able to figure out what. 

Floor(s): 10-19
